title: Lenny runtime lifecycle events
description: JSON envelopes exchanged on the gateway↔adapter lifecycle channel. The channel itself is the LifecycleChannel bidirectional stream defined in lenny-adapter.proto; the proto carries each envelope as opaque bytes. This schema is the source of truth for the envelope payloads. See spec/15_external-api-surface.md §15.4 and spec/4_system-components.md §4.7.

lifecycle_capabilities.title: lifecycle_capabilities
lifecycle_capabilities.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime), first message after the lifecycle channel opens. Advertises the set of lifecycle event types the adapter supports for this session. The runtime replies with lifecycle_support naming the subset it implements.

checkpoint_quiesce_deadline_ms.description: Time the adapter will wait between checkpoint_request and checkpoint_ready before treating the runtime as unresponsive.

interrupt_deadline_ms.description: Time the adapter will wait between interrupt_request and interrupt_acknowledged before escalating to SIGTERM.

lifecycle_support.title: lifecycle_support
lifecycle_support.description: Outbound (runtime → adapter), reply to lifecycle_capabilities. The runtime declares the subset of advertised capabilities it implements. The adapter records this on the LifecycleChannel handshake (§15.4.6 Full-level test: lifecycle channel opening).

runtime_version.description: Free-form version string used in the §16.4 runtime_version log field and the §15.4.6 conformance report.

checkpoint_request.title: checkpoint_request
checkpoint_request.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). Asks the runtime to reach a quiescent state so the adapter can take a consistent snapshot. The runtime replies with checkpoint_ready when output has been flushed and no in-flight tool calls are pending. See spec §15.4.3 Full level checkpoint/restore.

checkpoint_ready.title: checkpoint_ready
checkpoint_ready.description: Outbound (runtime → adapter). The runtime has quiesced and is holding new work until checkpoint_complete arrives.

checkpoint_complete.title: checkpoint_complete
checkpoint_complete.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). Releases the runtime from quiescence. The runtime resumes normal processing.

interrupt_request.title: interrupt_request
interrupt_request.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). Asks the runtime to reach a safe stop point and acknowledge with interrupt_acknowledged within the deadline. The runtime SHOULD stop producing new output and flush any pending output before acknowledging.

interrupt_acknowledged.title: interrupt_acknowledged
interrupt_acknowledged.description: Outbound (runtime → adapter). The runtime has reached a safe stop point. The original interrupt_id is echoed.

credentials_rotated.title: credentials_rotated
credentials_rotated.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). The adapter has updated the credentials available to the runtime (typically by rewriting the adapter manifest). Runtimes that declared credential_rotation in lifecycle_support MUST re-read credentials from the manifest path or env before serving the next request.

deadline_signal.title: deadline_signal
deadline_signal.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). The session deadline has been reached. The runtime SHOULD emit a final response (possibly with error.code="DEADLINE_EXCEEDED") and exit cleanly before deadline_ms elapses.

deadline_approaching.title: deadline_approaching
deadline_approaching.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). The session deadline is within deadline_warning_ms of expiry. The runtime SHOULD wrap up in-flight work and prepare a final response.

draining.title: draining
draining.description: Inbound (adapter → runtime). The pod is entering a graceful drain. The runtime SHOULD complete in-flight work and avoid starting new tool calls. A shutdown stdin message follows when the drain budget expires.
